quests.title: The Matched Socket
quests.premise: A carved block in a merchant's new frontage matches a lifting socket at the Robbed City. No other frontage on the street has been checked.

quests.title: Weighed at the Gate
quests.premise: A toll clerk is found dead on the causeway. His coat holds two versions of the same day's takings.

quests.title: The Tag Not Returned
quests.premise: A bone-tag comes back to the Tag House for a woman. Her family were told she walked out years ago.

quests.title: Two Claims on Cordon Two
quests.premise: A cellar guild holds written title to an under-store. A freed household holds written title to the same under-store.

quests.title: The Ledger Copies
quests.premise: Three copies of the Blackguards' ledger exist. They disagree in the entries that would convict a named officer.

quests.title: What Comes Up the Slip
quests.premise: Something is taking ferry passengers off the north stage. It does so after dark.

quests.title: Sour Ground, Sweet Well
quests.premise: The eastern wells of the city turn foul. This happens whenever road crews dig on the Counting Ground.

quests.title: Under the Reckoning
quests.premise: Cargo passes the Water Reckoning uncounted. It goes through a channel. The toll-keepers helped to cut the channel.

quests.title: The Under-Counting
quests.premise: Names are read aloud each night in a holding pit. The pit has stood empty for a century.

quests.title: Speaking Below the Water
quests.premise: The speakers of the drowned Hist cannot agree who may go down to it. The city wants a landing there.

quests.title: The Founding Page
quests.premise: The claim of a founding house to its seat rests on a page. Only the family has read the page.

quests.title: Bought Out of Cordon One
quests.premise: A family is raising the price of one man's release. They raise it faster than they can earn it.

quests.title: Given Field
quests.premise: A veteran wants the field where his company died reopened. The city entered the battle as a victory.

quests.title: The Blue Hole
quests.premise: A diver's chart shows the Blue Hole reaches the western feeder country. A buyer will pay to have the chart proved.

quests.title: The Price of the Causeway
quests.premise: The Rose wants the causeway toll. The city wants the causeway toll. Neither will repair the causeway.

quests.title: Sockets for a Larger Hand
quests.premise: Lifting gear at the Potentate's Works is sized for a hand. The hand is twice the span of a man's.

quests.title: The Yard's Missing Keel
quests.premise: A finished hull walks out of the Barge Yard overnight. Its papers are still on the bench.

quests.title: The Bricked Corner
quests.premise: A prison-born child is found dead at the foot of a stair. The stair was sealed two generations ago.

quests.title: The Gallery Crew
quests.premise: A dive crew was hired to survey the drowned gallery. The crew has not come back up.

quests.title: Whose Fox
quests.premise: Two households claim the same Lilmothiit fox carving. Neither will say how they came by it.

quests.title: The Unopened Cisterns
quests.premise: A water contractor certifies cisterns. He has not opened the cisterns.

quests.title: Lights Off the Track
quests.premise: The city's night carters are leaving the causeway for lights on the eastern fen.

quests.title: The Ration Store
quests.premise: Grain from a sealed cordon store has reached the city's market.

quests.title: Out on Another Name
quests.premise: A trafficker is moving living people out of the Rose. He uses the paperwork of the dead.

quests.title: The Refused Vault
quests.premise: Urns were turned away from every burial ground in the south. The urns have started answering each other.

quests.title: A Death Held Properly
quests.premise: A Nisswo asks the city to hold one death in the old order. The city buries by ledger.

quests.title: The Arbiter's Seat
quests.premise: The retired arbiter of the basin will not name a successor. Both candidates are her creditors.

quests.title: Third Generation
quests.premise: Prison-born households petition for city citizenship. Granting it would oblige Blackrose to state what the Rose is.

quests.title: Welloc's Lines
quests.premise: The city calls certain earthworks a rebel position. Its own garrison dug them.

quests.title: Fort Cordon
quests.premise: Something has moved into the abandoned fort. It pushes the city's patrol route further round the fort each month.

quests.title: A Charter With One Clause
quests.premise: The city offers the Chainbreakers a lawful charter. The charter has a single clause that they cannot sign.

quests.title: The Tally That Rises
quests.premise: The mass grave has tally stones. The tally stones show a number that keeps going up.

quests.title: A Week in the Ground
quests.premise: Grave-goods are on sale in the city. They were still buried last week.

quests.title: What Wide-Furrow Sends Back
quests.premise: A drowned village is returning objects. Its neighbours lost the objects this year.

quests.title: Bare Lake
quests.premise: The yearly drawdown of the lake has stranded something. The city wants it drowned again.

quests.title: The Rose's Account
quests.premise: Vaunting's carters want paying by the Rose directly. They do not want payment through the city's clerks.

quests.title: Cart Three Is Light
quests.premise: Every third cart up the causeway arrives short by the same weight.

quests.title: Two Sets of Scales
quests.premise: The town and the outworks weigh one load differently. Each weighs by its own lawful charter.

quests.title: Tags for the Living
quests.premise: Bone-tags are hung on the Tag House wall. They are for people who are still alive.

quests.title: Debt in Kind
quests.premise: An Owing is being settled in labour. The rates appear in no ledger.

quests.title: The Cordon Hearth
quests.premise: Vaunting keeps a fire for the cordon dead. The families of the Rose want the fire put out.

quests.title: The Carter's Widow
quests.premise: A carter dies on the causeway. His widow says the gate log of the Rose has been rewritten.

quests.title: The Windlass Reckoning
quests.premise: A portage windlass upriver carries its own tally of loads. The crew who could read the tally are gone.

quests.title: Three Rivers, One Price
quests.premise: Vaunting's price board quotes three rivers. The town no longer trades on those rivers.

quests.title: Off the Blackwood Road
quests.premise: Cargo booked for Gideon leaves Vaunting. It leaves by a different road every week.

quests.title: Rockspring's Water
quests.premise: A Vaunting buyer is drawing down Rockspring's spring. He does so under a lawful lease.

quests.title: Wide-Furrow
quests.premise: Saltrice lifted from the drowned fields is sold as sound. The buyers are falling ill.

quests.title: Bramman's Head
quests.premise: The whole crew of a landing has taken other work at a week's notice. The trading season is left unmanned.

quests.title: Ash-Hand
quests.premise: A Kothringi ruin holds the town's own founders. The town quarries the ruin for hardcore.

quests.title: The Trodden Ground
quests.premise: A marsh giant has settled across the dry line. Vaunting's drovers use that line to reach the north.

quests.title: A Dead Licence
quests.premise: Vaunting's market charter names a family. The family died out sixty years ago.

quests.title: The Sealed Vault
quests.premise: Something in a sealed western vault consumes whatever is placed before it. It then falls silent.

quests.title: Under the Boards
quests.premise: Something is taking the landing's dogs. It takes them from beneath the walkways.

quests.title: The Night Poles
quests.premise: The landing's polers run unlit cargo across the lake. They do so for the toll tower's own clerks.

quests.title: Lake Meer
quests.premise: A xanmeer under the lake lights up. It does so on the nights when the oldest boardwalk of the landing works in its piles.

quests.title: The Register Below
quests.premise: Blackrose hires a dive to bring up a parish register. The register is from the village drowned on its shore.

quests.title: The Second Stage
quests.premise: The residents of Blackrose's lake quarter want their own ferry stage. The concession holds that one crossing is enough.

quests.title: Who Reads the Water
quests.premise: The lake-shore water-reader of Blackrose is dying. Her two apprentices were taught different readings.

quests.title: One Book, Three Hands
quests.premise: The day book of the toll tower agrees too well with the two books it copies. Two of the three books were written after the fact.

quests.title: Tolled in Person
quests.premise: Travellers who cannot pay at the toll tower are held. They are held to work the crossing itself.

quests.title: Provocation
quests.premise: A schemer wants a killing at Open House. The killing would let the city close it lawfully.

quests.title: The Spring Runs Red
quests.premise: Rockspring's spring runs red for three days each year. This year it has not stopped.
